:::{#sol-matadd-identity-proof}

Both sides are $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix),
so they are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
For each $i$ and $j$,

$$
\ba
(\matr{A} + \matr{0}_{m \times n})_{ij}
&= a_{ij} + (\matr{0}_{m \times n})_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= a_{ij} + 0
&& \text{(@def-zero-matrix)}
\\
&= a_{ij}.
&& \text{(adding } 0 \text{ to a number leaves it unchanged)}
\ea
$$

So $\matr{A} + \matr{0}_{m \times n} = \matr{A}$.

:::
